Privacy Policy

1. Information We Collect

Information you provide: name, email address, shipping/billing address, phone number, and payment information (processed securely by our payment provider — we do not store full card numbers).

Automatically collected information: IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, referring URLs, and approximate location, collected via cookies and similar technologies.

Information from third parties: data from analytics and advertising partners such as Google Analytics, Meta (Facebook/Instagram) Pixel, and TikTok Pixel, used to measure ad performance and site usage.

2. How We Use Information

To process and fulfill orders, including sharing necessary information with shipping carriers and fulfillment partners; to communicate with you about your order, account, or customer service inquiries; to send marketing communications, where permitted, which you may opt out of at any time; to improve our website, products, and customer experience; to detect, prevent, and address fraud, abuse, or security issues; and to comply with legal obligations.

We use cookies, pixels, and similar technologies to operate the site, remember preferences, analyze traffic, and measure the effectiveness of advertising, including Meta and TikTok advertising pixels that may track your activity on and off this site for ad targeting and measurement purposes. To exercise these rights, contact us at the email below. We will respond within the timeframe required by applicable law.

7. Children's Privacy

Our Services are not directed to children under 13 (or 16 where applicable), and we do not knowingly collect personal information from children. If we learn we have collected such information, we will delete it promptly.

8. Data Security

We implement reasonable administrative, technical, and physical safeguards to protect your information. However, no method of transmission or storage is 100% secure, and we cannot guarantee absolute security.

9. International Transfers

If you access the Services from outside the United States, your information may be transferred to, stored, and processed in the United States or other countries where our service providers operate.

Our site may contain links to third-party websites. We are not responsible for the privacy practices of those sites and encourage you to review their policies.

Shipping Policy

Last updated: August 2026

1. Processing Time

Orders are typically processed within 1-2 business days of purchase. Processing times may be extended during high-volume periods (holidays, promotions) or due to circumstances outside our control.

2. Shipping Time

Because products ship directly from our supplier/fulfillment partner, delivery typically takes 5-12 business days within the continental United States after processing. These are estimates only, not guarantees, and actual delivery times may vary due to carrier delays, customs processing, weather, or other events outside our control.

3. Shipping Costs

Free standard shipping is offered on qualifying orders as indicated at checkout. Any applicable shipping fees will be clearly displayed before you complete your purchase.

4. Order Tracking

Once your order ships, you will receive a confirmation email with tracking information where available. Please allow up to 48 hours for tracking information to update after it is issued.

5. Shipping Address Accuracy

You are responsible for providing an accurate and complete shipping address. We are not responsible for orders delayed, lost, or misdelivered due to incorrect address information provided at checkout. If you notice an error, contact us as soon as possible — we cannot guarantee a change once an order has entered fulfillment.

6. Lost, Delayed, or Stolen Packages

Once a package is marked as delivered by the carrier, ElevateStep is not responsible for packages that are lost, stolen, or misdelivered after delivery confirmation. If your tracking shows delivered but you have not received your package, please contact the carrier directly and reach out to us so we can assist where possible; assistance is offered on a case-by-case, good-faith basis and is not a guarantee of replacement or refund.

7. International Shipping

If international shipping is offered, the recipient is responsible for any customs duties, import taxes, or fees imposed by the destination country. These charges are separate from our shipping costs and are outside our control.

8. Multiple Shipments

Orders containing multiple items may occasionally ship separately or from different fulfillment locations. This does not incur additional shipping charges to you.

9. Force Majeure

We are not liable for delays or failures in shipping caused by events beyond our reasonable control, including but not limited to natural disasters, carrier disruptions, customs delays, labor disputes, or public health emergencies.

10. Contact

Return & Refund Policy

Last updated: August 2026

1. 30-Day Return Window

We offer a 30-day return window from the date of delivery. To be eligible for a return, items must be unused, in their original condition, and in the original packaging where reasonably possible. We reserve the right to refuse a return that does not meet these conditions.

2. How to Start a Return

Contact us at support@elevatestep.com with your order number and reason for return. We will provide instructions. Returns sent without prior authorization may experience delays in processing.

3. Return Shipping

Unless the return is due to our error (wrong item shipped, defective product) or required by law, the customer is responsible for return shipping costs. We recommend using a trackable shipping method, as we are not responsible for return packages lost in transit.

4. Refunds

Once your return is received and inspected, we will notify you of the approval or rejection of your refund. Approved refunds will be issued to your original payment method within 5-10 business days. Original shipping charges, where applicable, are non-refundable except where required by law or where the return is due to our error.

5. Exchanges

We are happy to offer exchanges for a different size/layer option, subject to availability, within the same 30-day window. Contact us to arrange an exchange.

6. Non-Returnable Situations

We reserve the right to deny a return or refund in cases including but not limited to: signs of excessive wear or damage not caused by a manufacturing defect, items returned after the 30-day window, or suspected abuse of the return policy (e.g., repeated returns of the same item).

7. Damaged or Defective Items

If your item arrives damaged or defective, contact us within 7 days of delivery with photos of the issue so we can resolve it quickly, which may include a replacement, exchange, or refund at our discretion.

8. Late or Missing Refunds

If you haven't received a refund after the timeframe above, first check with your bank or card provider, as processing times vary. If you've done this and still have not received your refund, contact us.

9. Order Cancellations

Orders may be canceled for a full refund if the request is made before the order has shipped. Once an order has shipped, it is subject to this Return & Refund Policy rather than cancellation.

10. Policy Changes

We may update this policy at any time. The version in effect at the time of your purchase will govern that order.

11. Contact

Questions about returns or refunds can be sent to support@elevatestep.com.
